name: Brevo AI
tagline: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) is an all-in-one marketing platform with AI-driven email campaign generation, send-time optimisation, and a generative AI writing assistant. It offers email, SMS, WhatsApp marketing, and a built-in CRM, making it popular with SMBs managing marketing across multiple channels.
